My Top 5 Property Management Podcasts

UPDATED: September 2023

I’ve listened to a lot of podcasts about property management. I even host one of my own. But today I’m going to share with you a list of my top 5 favorite shows. All of these are highly educational and informative, and several have altered the course of my business, my life, or both.

In no particular order, my five favorite property management podcasts:

  • The Profitable Property Management Podcast (the back catalog is pure gold too) hosted by Jordan Muela.

  • 300 to 3,000 hosted by Matthew Whitaker & Spencer Sutton of Evernest.

  • The Property Management Mastermind Show hosted by Brad Larsen of RentWerx.

  • The PM Business Podcast hosted by Marc Cunningham of PM Build.

  • Triple Win Property Management Podcast by Andrew Smallwood of Second Nature.

Enjoy!
